card.name: Odd letter pieces inside abbreviations
card.fires_on: Short letter pieces in the middle or end of an abbreviation or odd spelling, such as the 'r', 'd' or 'f' in biosimilar suffixes (-mrbb, -strf), regimen codes (-Pd), and state or company abbreviations (Md., PdVSA).

modes.label: Biosimilar suffixes
modes.description: A single letter in the four-letter suffix added to a biologic drug name.

modes.label: Regimen and place abbreviations
modes.description: A lone letter inside a capitalized abbreviation such as a treatment regimen, state or company name.

modes.description: A letter piece inside a misspelled or scan-broken word.
